title: Th2 cell-mediated ferroptosis as a driver of sebaceous gland dysfunction in atopic dermatitis.
snippet: Atopic dermatitis (AD) is a chronic inflammatory skin disease accompanied by reduced sebum production and skin dryness, yet the functional states of the sebaceous gland (SG, a key tissue for sebum production) in the pathogenesis of AD remain unclear.
